short_answer: CFG controls prompt pressure, not quality.
operator_model: Low CFG lets the model lean on its learned prior; higher CFG pushes harder toward the text prompt.
aiwf_rule: Do not teach CFG as a quality slider.

short_answer: Denoise controls how much permission the model has to rewrite the source image.
operator_model: Low denoise preserves; high denoise transforms.
aiwf_rule: If the edit barely moves, raise denoise slowly; if the image stops being itself, lower denoise.

short_answer: Img2img adds noise to an existing image and denoises it back under prompt guidance.
operator_model: The input image is a starting point, not a locked canvas.
failure_signatures: not enough change at low strength
aiwf_rule: Img2img is controlled rewriting, not direct Photoshop editing.

short_answer: The mask tells the workflow where the edit is allowed or expected.
operator_model: Active/white regions are edited; protected/black regions are preserved; soft edges blend better than hard edges.
aiwf_rule: A mask is a contract, not just a selection.

short_answer: In ComfyUI, the mask must reach the latent/sampler path to affect generation.
operator_model: A visible mask preview is not enough; the sampler must receive the masked latent/noise-mask path.
failure_signatures: mask preview looks right but sampler edits whole image
aiwf_rule: Verify the mask at the sampler path, not just at the UI input.

short_answer: Tune mask, denoise, prompt, and control/reference together.
operator_model: Inpainting is a four-way negotiation: source preservation, prompt pressure, mask boundary, and model prior.
aiwf_rule: If the task needs structure, use structure control. If it needs identity, use identity/reference control.
